_about: Inputs of fig_src/make_tables_v3.py that are not plain JSON paths of our own result files.
No number is typed here. A competitor number is given as a 'quote': an exact substring of a field of
kanit/boyut_20261105/rakip_boyutlari_dogrulanmis.json (two-agent verified sources). The script checks that the
quote occurs in that field, parses the first number of the quote and multiplies it by 'scale'. A 'path' term is a
key path into a measured JSON file (size_vpc.json, size_aed.json). Competitor AUCs are read from
kanit/avenue_etiket_20261105/diff.json ('avenue_label_key'). Text cells are qualitative summaries of the same
size JSON (fields per_scene_artifacts, training_on_target, portability); every number inside them is a {placeholder}
filled from a 'named' term. 'check' lists substrings that must occur in the source so that the text stays true.
'gflops': GFLOPs for the size table: 'none' (not found for the configuration used), 'eq', 'range' (over the
per-dataset models) or 'frame_crop' (per frame plus per object crop); terms as above.
'speed': the inference speed published by the competitor's own authors, for the 'Published speed' column of the
size table. 'values' and 'hardware' are short verbatim quotes of the competitor's paper (location and URL given;
table rows with whitespace collapsed); the script checks that each 'value' / 'name' occurs in its quote. 'cell' and
'note' are templates without digits: every number in them is a {placeholder} filled from 'values' or 'hardware'.
Each entry was checked against the downloaded paper by two research agents and once more against the PDF text
before it was added (2026-11-06); 'reported': false means the paper gives no speed for the configuration in the
